source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: A conversation with no current_node and no message timestamps.

Without current_node Apple sorts the mapping's values by message create_time. The values come from a dictionary with no defined order and the sort is not stable, so messages with equal or missing times come out in a different order on every run. The web app uses a stable sort and keeps the order of the keys in the JSON text for ties.
apple_behaviour: The message order changes from run to run. 8 runs of the same input produced 8 different orders; three of them are listed in apple_observed_orders. There is therefore no single result to record.
